name: Verify ticket matching routing keywords is assigned to correct resolver queue
objective: Validate that tickets with content matching configured routing keywords are automatically assigned to the corresponding resolver queue.
precondition: Routing rules are configured in the system (e.g., 'VPN' → Network Support queue).

steps.description: Create a ticket through the AI Assistant with content matching a routing keyword
steps.testData: "I cannot connect to VPN" (matches 'VPN' routing keyword)

steps.description: Verify the ticket is assigned to the correct resolver queue
steps.expectedResult: Assignment Group shows 'Network Support' (the queue mapped to 'VPN' keyword)
